style_brief.brand_voice: Warm, community-rooted, and motivational — Tenacity Volleyball Club speaks directly to Western Wisconsin families and athletes with an encouraging, family-run tone anchored in its core values of teamwork, determination, respect, and a growth mindset. The writing is earnest and celebratory (frequent congratulations to teams and athletes) while staying practical and informative about tryouts, registration, and recruiting. Overall it reads as a proud local youth-sports organization that champions development on the court and in life.
layout_conventions: Open the Home page with a full-bleed hero carrying the welcome headline and mission statement over a photo, followed by a prominent tryout-dates/registration CTA block
Lead the About Us page with the mission quote paired with a group action photo, then a 'Looking to Participate?' intro block
Lay out the Board page as a people-grid of headshot cards with name, role, and contact beneath a founders intro
Present informational pages (Tryouts, Recruiting, FAQ) as stacked heading + short-paragraph sections, each with an icon or partner logo and outbound link buttons to forms, docs, and registration
Render achievements, recognition, and news as celebratory announcement blocks (bold team callouts) followed by a photo gallery grid of season highlights
Use image-gallery grids of athlete/action photos as recurring section dividers between content blocks
Pin partner/affiliate logos (USAV, Badger Region, JVA) and a sponsor row near the footer, alongside contact info and Facebook/YouTube/Instagram social links
Keep CTAs visually distinct as button-style links to external registration forms, Google Docs, and sign-up sheets throughout the site

props.body:
Complete the following steps before tryout day:

1. **[Create a SportsEngine Account](https://user.sportngin.com/setup/account)** — You must create an account or sign in to SportsEngine to register. The primary account holder MUST be a parent. Each child registering will need a unique sub-profile in the parent's primary account. Under no circumstances should an athlete register themselves. The primary user must be a parent/legal guardian at least 18 years of age.

2. **[Update USAV Membership](https://badgervolleyball.org/membership/)** — Follow the link that applies: New Member, Renewing/Upgrading/Current Member, or Transfer Member from another region.

3. **[Concussion Form](https://badgervolleyball.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/ConcussionInfoSigForms.pdf)** — All athletes are required to have BOTH forms filled out before the day of tryouts. These forms need to be printed out and turned into Tenacity Volleyball Club on the day of tryouts.

4. **[Medical Release](https://badgervolleyball.org/medical-release-form-without-notary/)** — All athletes are required to have BOTH forms filled out before the day of tryouts. These forms need to be printed out and turned into Tenacity Volleyball Club on the day of tryouts.

blocks.source_brief: Page title heading 'FACTS & QUESTIONS'
blocks.source_quote: ## FACTS & QUESTIONS

props.body: Club volleyball is an opportunity to play volleyball outside of high or middle school ball. The players will be a part of an organization that will arrange for team practices, coaches, uniforms, and tournaments. Tenacity season starts in November and goes until March. We will have teams ranging from 12s to 17s level of play.

Badger region is a nonprofit membership organization dedicated to providing a high-quality volleyball experience to its members. Badger is one of the 40 regions of USA Volleyball. Badger is the Wisconsin chapter of USA volleyball and the premier volleyball authority in the state. Tenacity is a badger-sanctioned club. We must follow all rules set by Badger.

props.alt: Leading Edge Chiropractic Ladies' Night fundraiser

props.body: Yes, we currently work with Leading Edge Chiropractic on a Ladies' Night event. Players will sell tickets to these events and keep the profit from the ticket sales. More information will follow when the season comes.

props.text: How many competition dates will be in season?

props.body: Players on 1s team will receive 12–14 competition days. Players on 2s team will receive 8–10 competition days.
Please message the club at **tenacityvolleyballclub@outlook.com**.
